title: 第1549章 汤玉辉的阳谋第1548章 这年轻人的城府好深
slug: 剑道圣体的我只想躺平
content_zh:
他站起身，活动了一下手腕，骨节发出咔嗒轻响。
正当几人议论的时候，外面有士兵传信说统帅让他去议事厅一趟。
传令兵气喘吁吁，躬身递上令牌。
苗诗烟凝重道：“不能去，那家伙肯定挖个坑等你跳呢。”
她一把按住秦峰手臂，指尖微微发凉，满是担忧。
花不羁也道：“没想到这家伙报复来这么快，就不去，看他还能怎样。”
他拍着桌子，脸上横肉抖动，恨不得替秦峰回绝。
秦峰道：“咱们这边主要是来肃清后方，但镇邪关他还是一把手。”
他拨开苗诗烟的手，神色从容，嘴角甚至带着一丝浅笑。
“如果抗命，反而让他抓住了把柄，我去看看也无妨，他还不敢直接动手。”
最后他带了苗诗烟一起，让花不羁留在院子。
很快，秦峰就在议事厅看到了汤玉辉坐在主座之上。
厅内烛火通明，汤玉辉居高临下，目光阴沉如鹰隼。
下面坐着都尉跟几名校尉，等于镇邪关的中高层都来了。
几人分列两侧，有的低头喝茶，有的打量秦峰。
其中就有之前在城门拦他的那名校尉吴大奎。
吴大奎抱着胳膊，嘴角挂着讥诮，眼中却藏着一丝忌惮。
汤玉辉皮笑肉不笑道：“秦大人，有一件事要与你商量。”
他假笑堆在脸上，眼底却冷得像冰。
秦峰有一种不好的预感，不过还是道：“统帅有什么事不妨直说。”

他立在厅中央，脊背挺直，声音清朗不卑不亢。
汤玉辉道：“是这样的，我们有一名校尉，名叫黄云，他前一段时间被祈灵神朝蛊惑。”
“现在已经叛逃出了镇邪关，还带走了我们的布防图，这对我们未来的战事极为不利。”
他把茶盏搁下，发出清脆一响，厅内气氛骤然绷紧。
“秦大人智谋无双，不如就由你亲自去把他抓回来，如何？”
他摊开双手，一副推心置腹的模样，可眼神却闪着寒光。
秦峰哪里还不明白，对方这就是想把他调出去。
他心头冷笑，面上不动声色。不过想必黄云的事情应该是真的，否则日后书院查起来，汤玉辉也兜不住。
叛逃之事必有记录，汤玉辉不敢拿假情报坑杀同僚。
追查奸细跟叛变之人也是秦峰的职责所在，这是妥妥的阳谋。
他接下便是以身犯险，不接便是抗命失职，进退两难。
秦峰道：“但是现在可能已经跑到祈灵神朝了，我又怎么追得上？”
他故意皱眉，显出为难之态，想看看对方还有什么后手。
汤玉辉微微一笑，似乎是早有准备，他拿出一只飞虫。
那飞虫通体碧绿，翅翼薄如蝉翼，在烛光下泛着幽光。
然后对秦峰道：“放心吧，我早就给你想好办法了。”
他将飞虫托在掌心，虫须轻轻颤动，朝着西北方向微微偏转。
“此人之前就是怀疑对象，他身上有一股香味。我手上的小虫可以凭借此味儿寻找他。”
那香味是一种罕见的狐涎香，沾衣三日不散，寻常人闻不到。
“你只是顺着它飞的方向，一路追踪就好了。”
content_en:
He stood up and moved his wrists, and the joints made a soft clicking sound.
While several people were discussing, a soldier outside sent a message saying that the commander-in-chief asked him to go to the meeting hall.
The orderly soldier was panting and bowed to hand over the token.
Miao Shiyan said solemnly: "You can't go, that guy will definitely dig a hole for you to jump into."
She held Qin Feng's arm, her fingertips felt slightly cold, and she was full of worry.
Hua Buzhi also said: "I didn't expect this guy's revenge to come so quickly, so I won't go and see what else he can do."
He slapped the table, his face trembling, wishing he could refuse Qin Feng.
Qin Feng said: "Our main purpose here is to clear the rear, but he is still the leader of Zhenxie Pass."
He pushed Miao Shiyan's hand away with a calm expression and even a slight smile on his lips.
"If you disobey and let him grab the handle, it doesn't matter if I go and take a look. He doesn't dare to take action directly yet."
In the end, he took Miao Shiyan with him and let Hua Buji stay in the yard.
Soon, Qin Feng saw Tang Yuhui sitting on the main seat in the meeting hall.
The hall was brightly lit with candles, and Tang Yuhui stood condescendingly, his eyes as gloomy as an eagle's.
Sitting below were the captain and several school captains, which meant that all the middle and high-level officials of Zhenxie Pass were here.
Several people lined up on both sides, some bowed their heads to drink tea, and some looked at Qin Feng.
Among them was the captain Wu Dakui who had stopped him at the city gate before.
Wu Dakui crossed his arms with sarcasm on his lips, but there was a hint of fear in his eyes.
Tang Yuhui smiled and said, "Master Qin, I have something to discuss with you."
He had a fake smile on his face, but his eyes were as cold as ice.
Qin Feng had a bad premonition, but he still said: "Commander, if you have anything to do, you may as well just say it."
He stood in the center of the hall, his back straight, his voice clear and neither humble nor arrogant.
Tang Yuhui said: "It's like this. We have a school captain named Huang Yun. He was bewitched by the Qiling Divine Dynasty some time ago."
"Now he has defected from Zhenxie Pass and taken away our defense map. This is extremely detrimental to our future wars."
He put down the teacup and made a crisp sound, and the atmosphere in the hall suddenly became tense.
"Master Qin is extremely resourceful. How about you go and capture him yourself?"
He spread his hands and looked sincere, but his eyes shone coldly.
Qin Feng still didn't understand that the other party wanted to transfer him out.
He sneered in his heart and remained calm on his face. But Huang Yun's story must be true, otherwise Tang Yuhui wouldn't be able to handle it if the academy investigates it in the future.
The defection must be recorded, and Tang Yuhui did not dare to use false information to trap his colleagues.
It is also Qin Feng's responsibility to track down spies and traitors. This is a complete conspiracy.
If he accepts it, he will be in danger; if he does not accept it, he will be disobedient and derelict in his duties, and he will be in a dilemma.
Qin Feng said: "But now I may have reached the Praying Spirit Dynasty, how can I catch up?"
He frowned deliberately, showing an awkward attitude, wanting to see what other tricks the other party had.
Tang Yuhui smiled slightly, as if he had been prepared, he took out a flying insect.
The flying insect was green all over, its wings were as thin as cicada wings, and glowed dimly in the candlelight.
Then he said to Qin Feng: "Don't worry, I have already thought of a solution for you."
He held the flying insect in his palm, and the insect's whiskers trembled slightly, deflecting slightly towards the northwest.
"This person has been a suspect before. He has a scent on his body. The bug on my hand can use this scent to find him."
The fragrance is a rare fox saliva fragrance that sticks to clothes for three days and cannot be smelled by ordinary people.
"You just need to follow the direction it flies and follow it all the way."
